findings.summary: Made Worker own its Inbox directly, removing duplicate control state, allocation and termination atomics.
Consolidated SDL renderer cleanup into one scope guard while preserving upload-resource destruction before device release.
Removed the unused canvas-element clone value kind.
Changed Window endpoint registration to weak references and pruned expired owners.
Keep ResizeObservers registered only while actively observing and use factory-provided weak identity compatible with the GC allocator.
Build document snapshots outside the presentation mutex.
Check compositor frame capacity before recording UI, and retire completed Dawn leases before notifying producers.
Bound canceled timer heap growth through threshold-based compaction.
Sort structured-clone field metadata once and add lazy indexing only for wide objects, retaining linear lookup for small messages.
Reuse unwrapExpression and rootIdentifier for Worker discovery and capture analysis.
Reuse propertyName and validateObjectProperties for worker and asset options, including quoted keys.
Reuse PlatformEventListeners for MediaQueryList listener identity and dispatch.
Resolve borrowed canvas textures explicitly in the existing SDL and Dawn UI renderers without inserting them into owning texture caches; ordinary rendering compiles out the resolver.
Remove the standalone proof host and its scheduler policy; OffscreenRun now owns only surface binding and publication, while the Window supplies animation notifications.
Keep recorded UI frames by reference and copy them only for canvas-only capture filtering.
Centralize browser capture package-entry routing in pinnedPackageSpecifiers.
Replace obsolete prototype workflow documentation with the registered application and targeted interaction/cadence commands.
